points.label: What follows
points.left: Apollos teaches accurately about Jesus while knowing only John’s baptism, then receives fuller explanation from Priscilla and Aquila.
points.right: Paul meets disciples who know John’s baptism but have not heard of the Holy Spirit; he restates John’s forward-pointing message before baptism in Jesus’ name.

payload.posture: Inspect both Scripture WEBU sources while preserving their speakers, setting, sequence, and distinct claims about John.

rightEvidence.title: John’s baptism, no knowledge of the Spirit, baptism in Jesus’ name, and Spirit reception

payload.tension: John’s baptism remains meaningful in both scenes but is not the final point of either account.
payload.title: John’s baptism in two Ephesian scenes
